title: Remote build: a GitHub ref, PRs and CI where readable
goal: The same rows from `--remote owner/name@ref`, plus PR state and CI
acceptance: Failing test first on a fake GitHub client: a remote build of a fixture gives the local `dump`, plus PR state, merge time and CI result
Token from `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN`; without one, public data is read and the rest is a `problems` row; an unreadable repository is a `problems` row, never no work
No polling, ETags or service: those stay coordinator:F-024-T03's
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented; a token is read from the environment, never written.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the coordinator proposal's 4 h (live index decision page, row S1), failing test first. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-26 in #319.
